replaying a real historical sequencer batch (tx 0x44aca2f0..., block 89,792,031) as attacker -> NotSequencer; as the sequencer -> ActionAlreadyProcessed(0xb6132fdd) (monotonic lastActionId)

user signatures are EIP-712 (Meridian/1/chainId/verifyingContract=gateway) with per-(account,actionType,nonce) usedNonces, signedAt expiry buffers, Solady ECDSA (recovered==sender && recovered!=0) and ERC-1271 with 179k gas cap + strict magic value

InitiateWithdraw has no inline signature check by design: the user signature is carried in the action and enforced by CollateralManager.finalizeWithdraw (account.verifySignature); third-party finalize -> Unauthorized(), bogus digest -> WithdrawNotFound() (fork-proven)
direct ActionHandler calls are inert (own empty storage); gateway registry slot decodes to the verified handler address (fork-proven)
sequencer is a single EOA 0x39f7e293... (approved live; added block 48,039,484) -> P-class hot-key risk; owner is a 2-of-3 Safe
merUSD: totalSupply == USDe balance == 1,733,782.135870236e18 (exact 1:1); wrap/unwrap permissionless but restricted to the default wrapped token; non-default wrap reverts
